purpose: Record the symbol information that is actually present in the original ARM64 shared object.

binary.file_report: ELF 64-bit LSB shared object, ARM aarch64, version 1 (SYSV), dynamically linked, stripped

interpretation: The APK does not contain a full .symtab or DWARF debug record set.
The 8601 count is the applied IDA alias inventory, which includes IDA-visible dynamic names together with separate PLT, jump-thunk, and data aliases.
The 6506 count is the defined-row total reported from the surviving dynamic symbol table and is not interchangeable with the alias inventory.
The remaining source names cannot be recovered from this APK alone when a function has no dynamic name, debug record, or reliable sibling-ABI match.
raw_command_policy: The audit was performed against the private extracted library. The APK and native library remain outside the public repository.
